# openai/tunnel-client

The Windows WebHarness bundle includes `openai/tunnel-client` version 0.0.12.

- Source: https://github.com/openai/tunnel-client
- License: Apache License 2.0
- License text: https://github.com/openai/tunnel-client/blob/master/LICENSE

The bundled executable is redistributed without modification. Its version and SHA-256 are verified during the release build and again before first local installation.
